task_summary: Integrate and independently validate full-circuit visual routing on an existing vehicle project and simulation site.
workflow_version: TeamHub evidence reuse, bounded native reviews, existing C replay pipeline and target IDE validation

acceptance: Full-map route comparison and inspectable visual evidence on the original website.
Compatible target-source integration with honest hardware/calibration boundaries.
Fault protection and source/CLI/browser consistency validated.
completed: Reused current collaborator route candidate and audited hardware pins, signs and units.
Fixed and fault-tested indefinite gyro hold after camera freeze.
Added full-map real-C replay and 29 landmark inspection links to the existing website; browser and all replay checks passed.
Added default-disabled target route preset; actual ADS compiler/linker succeeded; calibration gate tests passed.
remaining: Real camera and odometry calibration, physical direction checks and autonomous finish stopping remain required.
Full-map symbol-name classification is not implemented; current objective tested is planned traversal.
Independent Opus acceptance of this round corrections remains pending.

observations: Reusing the collaborator candidate avoided another controller implementation; no matched workflow baseline supports a speedup percentage.
Independent review found stale-camera bypass, host-only route provisioning, evaluation-only lap ending and calibration sensitivity.
Browser validation caught null-HEX rendering failure that source-data tests missed; corrected and rechecked both screen widths.
Initial server absent after interruption; original start entry restored after database backup and migration plan check.
Repeated oversized reads and one accidental invalid WSL invocation added overhead; no data loss. Standalone compiler/headless IDE failures required the supported GUI build path.

recommendations.action: Require a target route initialization check and a sensor-dropout test whenever simulated full-lap success is proposed for hardware.
recommendations.next_check: Next route revision reproduces frozen-frame stop and target preset gates before promotion.

recommendations.action: Separate plant truth from controller calibration in validation; include odometry and camera errors before any real-car reliability claim.
recommendations.next_check: After measured calibration, rerun at least +/-5 percent odometry and measured camera-height/pitch uncertainty.

limits: Real camera and odometry calibration, physical direction checks and autonomous finish stopping remain required.
Full-map symbol-name classification is not implemented; current objective tested is planned traversal.
